examined_formations.title: ENTERPRISE_AI_AGENT_RUNTIME_ENFORCEMENT
examined_formations.chinese_title: 企业AI智能体运行时身份与动作强制控制
examined_formations.observed_residual_leakage: Enterprises still report many agents without oversight/logging and difficulty moving from discovery to real-time enforcement.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: The leakage is real, but Microsoft Entra, CrowdStrike, Noma, Delinea, Entro, Cisco and others now expose agent identity, least-privilege, runtime authorization, discovery and enforcement. Remaining leakage is primarily deployment/coverage rather than a clean neutral action edge.

examined_formations.title: VENDOR_ONBOARDING_DOCUMENT_AND_APPROVAL_ORCHESTRATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 供应商准入资料与审批编排
examined_formations.observed_residual_leakage: Current organizations still use email, spreadsheets, PDFs and disconnected approval chains for vendor onboarding.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: The manual behavior remains observable, but current vendor-onboarding portals and workflow automation products directly centralize intake, document collection, review, approvals and ERP hand-offs. The residual is adoption/integration work, not an unowned machine action.

examined_formations.title: SUPPLIER_SCOPE3_PRIMARY_DATA_COLLECTION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 供应链Scope 3原始排放数据收集
examined_formations.observed_residual_leakage: Supplier response chasing, data quality and source-system movement remain recurring work even for sustainability teams.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current platforms already provide supplier portals, questionnaires, reminders, ERP/API imports, data-quality scoring and disclosure outputs. Non-response and low-quality source data are participant/data constraints that a thin new software layer does not uniquely control.

examined_formations.title: CREATOR_MULTI_BRAND_PAYOUT_RECONCILIATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 创作者多品牌合作结算对账
examined_formations.observed_residual_leakage: Agencies still reconcile creator balances, invoices, sponsorship budgets and payment status in spreadsheets and reminders.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Melon, Scoop and current campaign systems directly track deal-level balances, milestones, invoices, sponsor attribution and payout status. Fragmented underlying payment rails remain, but the software control surface is already productized.

examined_formations.title: HEALTHCARE_PRIOR_AUTHORIZATION_ADMIN_AUTOMATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 医疗事前授权行政流程自动化
examined_formations.observed_residual_leakage: Practices still re-key clinical facts, use payer portals/fax/phone, chase status and rebuild denied cases.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Multiple current platforms automate requirement lookup, evidence assembly, submission, status polling and denial workflows. The remaining hard layer is payer heterogeneity and clinical judgment rather than a founder-independent unowned digital edge.

examined_formations.title: CONSTRUCTION_CHANGE_ORDER_FIELD_TO_OFFICE_CAPTURE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 施工变更单现场到办公室闭环
examined_formations.observed_residual_leakage: Verbal field approvals, delayed documentation and disconnected cost/approval records still create disputes and leakage.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current paid products already capture field evidence, route approvals, synchronize budgets/costs and maintain audit trails. Continued verbal/off-system work reflects adoption and field discipline rather than a missing control surface.
